lesson: Nemo holographic memory was missing - both local and Telegram layers were empty. Initialized fresh. Must back up to Telegram after creation.

8 scanner files had overlapping logic. Best approach: single unified engine with configurable parameters. ATR-based targets outperform fixed percentages because they adapt to each stock's volatility. Backtest cooldown (30 bars between signals per stock) is essential for realistic evaluation. nsepython works for live data but yfinance is more reliable for historical 5-min data. Shoonya connector was dead code (API-only user can't auth).

Optimal params found: ADX>=25 + RVOL>=1.3 + min_score>=12 + ATR 1.5x/0.75x. Best 3-day backtest: 191 trades, 49.7% win rate, Sharpe 1.81, +10.15% return. 5-min timeframe needs 24-bar max hold (2 hours) to let target play out. Fixed percentage targets are inferior to ATR-based ones.
Wedding photos and Instagram carousel scripts were mixed into trading directory under backtests/DropZone/. Moved to dedicated nemo_trading_content/ folder.
